changelog:
Initial release of the carbon-accounting-check skill:

- Provides a structured review for greenhouse gas (GHG) inventories before reporting or audit.
- Outputs include: boundary review, data-quality assessment, emission-factor sensitivity list, year-over-year (YoY) bridge, and a prioritized list of issues to fix.
- Supports scope 1/2/3 checks, including scope 2 dual reporting and 15-category scope 3 screening.
- Assigns data-quality tiers to each emission source and highlights those affecting headline claims.
- Provides clear output with flags, severities, and concrete fixes, along with guidance for disclosure and compliance team review.
